q_high.title: A Physics-Guided Aeromagnetic Interference Compensation Method for Geomagnetic Sensing in GNSS-Denied UAV Swarm Systems
q_high.headline_result:
| metric | value + unit | baseline value | page |
|--------|--------------|----------------|------|
| STD (Flt_3) | 26.64 nT | TL: 179.99 nT | 14 |
| STD (Flt_7) | 24.15 nT | TL: 95.12 nT | 14 |
| IR (Flt_3) | 14.26 | TL: 2.11 | 15 |
| IR (Flt_7) | 16.27 | TL: 4.13 | 15 |
| Inference latency | 94 μs per sample | NOT_REPORTED | 17 |

"PG-TLNet achieves an the standard deviation (STD) of 26.64 nT, representing 85.2% reduction relative to the T-L model (179.99 nT)." [p.13-14]
"For the more challenging Flt_7 flight, the STD is further reduced to 24.15 nT, corresponding to a 74.61% improvement over the T-L baseline (95.12 nT)." [p.14]
"The total processing time for 274,480 samples was 25.72 s, corresponding to an average per-sample latency of approximately 0.094 ms (94 μs)." [p.17]
q_high.metrics: STD (Flt_3), STD (Flt_7), IR (Flt_3), IR (Flt_7), Inference latency
q_high.limitations: "First, under extreme electrical fault conditions, such as sudden high-current surges or abnormal electromagnetic coupling events, the linear-nonlinear hybrid structure may experience temporary performance degradation due to out-of-distribution signals. Second, in dense swarm operations, potential electromagnetic coupling among closely spaced UAVs may introduce additional interference components that are not explicitly modeled in the present framework." [p.23]
